### 1. P2P AllReduce (`allreduce-p2p.cu`) — In-Graph Cross-GPU Synchronization

The implementation provides a **lock-free, graph-capturable** AllReduce for tensor-parallel inference across up to 8 CUDA devices using peer-to-peer memory access.

- **Fixed grid geometry** (`P2P_AR_BLOCKS=8`, `P2P_AR_THREADS=512`): Every call uses all blocks so per-block epoch counters stay synchronized. A variable grid would desynchronize the double-buffer half selection (`ep & 1`).
